name: Helen Hay Whitney Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowship
amount: USD 73,000 / 75,000 / 77,000 stipend (years 1-3) + USD 1,500/year research allowance + USD 1,500/year per child
other_rules: PhD within 2 years of the deadline (MD or MD-PhD within 4 years)
no more than 1 year in the postdoc lab at the deadline
US citizens may train in the US, Canada or abroad
non-US citizens must train in US labs
notes: Basic biomedical sciences. Deadline 15 June each year (5 pm EST). Only 3-year awards.
